content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘Personal Property’ includes all tangible and intangible personal property owned by the Grantor as of the date of this Will.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSITION_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: All Personal Property shall be distributed equally among my children: John, Jane, and James.

content_blocks.label: clause_3.1_EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: Ethan Grey is hereby appointed Executor of this Will and shall carry out the provisions hereof.
